clips.title: The story
paras: West of Dolanaar, Moon Priestess Amara watches Teldrassil’s road to Darnassus. Two huntresses guard her as she keeps watch over the woodland paths.

Moon Priestess Amara watches the road west of Dolanaar with two huntress companions, Nhemai and Yaeliura. As a priestess of the Sisterhood of Elune, she brings spiritual guidance to her post, while her watch helps keep Teldrassil’s roads secure. Travelers heading west can seek her direction toward Darnassus. Those burdened in spirit can also seek a path of redemption from her.
